No outcome, arrival report, or news-conference readout appeared in the 11:00-12:00 window; in-window returns are pre-visit announcements only (Ukranews updated 07:45+02, CNBC TV18, Sunday Guardian live). Zelenskyy's stated November expectation stands: movement toward long-discussed formats, with a hoped-for Ukraine-Russia-US trilateral in Abu Dhabi Nov 6-10.
